name: yt-feather-highlight
title: Feathered Spotlight
description: Spotlights part of the host's frame: a dim layer in the reel's ground colour with a feathered elliptical hole fades in, glides to the next target and releases. Helpers ytHighlightIn/To/Out wire it onto any frame.

variables.label: Across
variables.description: Horizontal centre of the spotlight, percent of the frame width.

variables.label: First target
variables.description: Vertical centre of the first spotlit area, percent of the frame height.

variables.label: Second target
variables.description: Vertical centre the spotlight glides to, percent of the frame height.
